arabic: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ، وَالِاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ فِي التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ.
transliteration: Whoever memorizes the first ten verses of Surat Al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal. One should also seek refuge with Allah from his trials in the final Tashahhud of every prayer.
translation: Whoever memorizes the first ten verses of Surat Al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal. One should also seek refuge with Allah from his trials in the final Tashahhud of every prayer.
